tagline: European inland waterway shipping association representing industry, insurance and survey interests
hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects the scale and reach of the association's influence in the European inland shipping sectors, including industry, insurance, and technical surveying.

kpis.name: Members and Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of members and participants from European inland shipping industry, insurance and survey sectors.
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt hosted 225 participants from 11 countries, demonstrating the association's role as a pan-European platform for inland shipping stakeholders.
kpis.signal: Indicates the reach and influence of the association across the European inland waterway sector.

kpis.name: Geographic Coverage
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in the association's membership and activities.
kpis.description: The IVR represents member interests across 11 European countries, establishing itself as a truly international organization for inland shipping coordination.
kpis.signal: Reflects the pan-European scope and influence of the organization.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in 2024.
kpis.description: The first IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, attracted 80 participants including insurers, brokers, surveyors and shipping companies from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany.
kpis.signal: Demonstrates engagement and interest in loss prevention and risk management within the inland shipping sector.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Countries
kpis.explanation: Number of countries represented at the Loss Prevention Colloquium.
kpis.description: The Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp attracted participants from 3 countries (Belgium, Netherlands, Germany), showing strong regional engagement in loss prevention and technical knowledge sharing.
kpis.signal: Indicates cross-border engagement in loss prevention initiatives.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Annual consolidated revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €1.81 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.68 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.29 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.06 Bn in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No explicit AI positioning identified. The organization focuses on traditional inland shipping industry representation, loss prevention, technical standards development through CESNI, and regulatory coordination.
evidence: Annual Report focuses on traditional shipping sector governance, safety, and standardization
References to digitalization in shipping mentioned in context of professional qualification standards, not AI-driven innovation
